title: Reward-Hacking Detection Harness for Verifiable Tasks

original_idea.body: # Reward-Hacking Detection Harness for Verifiable Tasks. ~10 tasks each with a brittle proxy and hidden true check; measure how often open models exploit the proxy; log CoT for hacking intent. Release harness.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Reward-hacking detection is a leading near-term misalignment signal; concrete safety infrastructure.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Tasks with proxy vs true checks + CoT logging; some harness engineering, mentor helps.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused harness with ~10 tasks; designing proxy/true check pairs is moderate effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Reusable detection harness on open models; labs underweight third-party tooling.

low_compute.reasoning: Agentic/coding inference on open models, single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Reward hacking studied in MALT/Petri; a turnkey verifiable-task harness plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Reward hacking studied; turnkey detection harness plausibly open.
